_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for SO retrospectives (retro/build_so.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date: a filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern; EDGAR records no time before 2003). Southern Company's earnings 8-Ks of Q2 2007 to Q3 2026 were accepted before the open or during the session on the release day (a Wednesday or Thursday, and Mondays 2012-11-05 and 2016-10-31). To 2016 the 10-Ks came weeks after the Q4 releases, so a Q4 print carries its year's actuals (fy_actual) until the 10-K; from the FY2016 10-K each 10-K was public the morning of its Q4 release, so no later Q4 print extends the history. No filing guides revenue or a margin in numbers, and none guides EPS except the Q4 2021 release, whose FY2022 adjusted EPS range is in 'eps_guides' (to 2011 the releases say earnings guidance is discussed on the analyst call; from Q2 2016 they point to earnings slides with an estimate or guidance on the company's website; no transcript or slides are filed). The company's EPS excluding only one-offs, where a filing states it, is in 'eps_bases' and the prints' notes (retro/README.md, 'SO 2010-2013', 'SO 2014-2017', 'SO 2018-2021' and 'SO 2022-2026'); FY2017, a distorted year, is in 'eps_excluded'. Generated by a script from row strings of the filings (each checked with retro/tools/verbatim.py); every growth rate, margin, margin change and rule-T value is computed. See retro/README.md, 'SO'.
